properties.displayName: MFA Token Theft — AiTM Phishing with Account Takeover
properties.description: Detects two correlated attack patterns indicative of Adversary-in-the-Middle (AiTM) phishing: (a) MFA method reset followed by password reset for the same user within a configurable window — indicates full account takeover after session token theft, (b) Sign-ins from multiple IPs for the same user within a short window — indicates stolen token replay from attacker infrastructure. MITRE ATT&CK: T1557.003 (AiTM), T1528 (Steal Application Access Token), T1556.006 (Modify Authentication Process: MFA).
